Pink City Jaipur gets UNESCO World Heritage tag

By:India Today - 06 July,2019

Short Detail

At the 43rd Session of the UNESCO World Heritage Committee which is underway from June 30 to July 10, 2019 in Baku, Azerbaijan, the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) added the ‘Pink City’ Jaipur/Walled City of Jaipur of Rajasthan, known for its iconic architectural legacy, into the list of the World Heritage Sites.

Pink City Jaipur. Source:The Hans India

Now the number of heritage sites across India in the UNESCO World Heritage list has increased to 38.

By:Business Standard - 06 July,2019

Short Detail

Arinjeeta Dey, a 10-year-old girl, has won a silver medal in the World Youth Cup held at Umag, Croatia. The tournament was organised by World Karate Federation affiliated to the International Olympic Association.

India to train 1800 Bangladeshi Civil Servants at Mussoorie

By:All India Radio - 05 July,2019

Short Detail

Eighteen hundred Bangladeshi mid-career civil servants will be trained at the National Centre for Good Governance (NCGG) in Mussoorie,Uttarakhand between 2019-2025.

By:APN News - 05 July,2019

Short Detail

The world’s largest burn and plastic surgery institute named Sheikh Hasina National Burn and Plastic Surgery Institute started its operation in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Genesis Foundation Awarded as CSR Implementation Partner in Leadership Category at CSR Health Impact Awards

By:THE WEEK - 05 July,2019

Short Detail

At the 3rd edition of CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) Health Impact Awards organized at Hyatt Regency in New Delhi, Gurgaon based Non-Profit Organization,Genesis Foundation was awarded as CSR Implementation Partner in the leadership category for its association with WPP India CSR Foundation for ‘Project Little Hearts’.

Genesis foundation. Source:OKListen

CBI Additional Director Nageswar Rao shifted to Fire Services department

By:The Hindu - 05 July,2019

Short Detail

IPS officer from Odisha cadre, M Nageswar Rao, has been removed from his current post of Additional Director of CBI and appointed as the Director General of Fire Services, Civil Defence and Home Guard by Central Government. He will continue this post till July 2020. He will succeed S.N Pradhan.

M Nageswar Rao. Source:indiatvnews.com

Short Detail

India to host 3rd global sunflower seed meet on July 19

By:The Hindu BusinessLine - 03 July,2019

Short Detail

India will host 3rd International Sunflower Seed and Oil Conference (ISSOC) 2019 on July 19 and 20 in Mumbai. the first 2 Conferences were held respectively in China and Ukraina.

Short Detail
